title: thelypteris palustris f. pubescens
intro: Thelypteris palustris f. pubescens, commonly known as the Marsh Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of fern that grows in wet environments, such as marshes and swamps, and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Thelypteris palustris f. pubescens include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
